status: development diagnostics; not a frozen held-out study
shared_task_freedom: Five explicit positions for block_0: original and four axis offsets of 6 cm; the other two blocks are fixed. All methods have the same allowed task positions and initial choice.
purpose: Check event-attributed repair, actual complete replanning, request preservation, and fixed-reference ablation. Record negative and unverified results.
cost_scope: Includes fresh state/reference acquisition and all subsequent stages. Precomputed asset creation is excluded and its historical cost is unknown.
limitations: A single seed does not establish method superiority or an overall success rate.
New position freedom makes these requests distinct from the earlier fixed-position requests.
Reference control uses a fixed grasp orientation and transfer order.
The distance-gain ranking is a heuristic; only full physical execution and validation provide acceptance evidence.
